Fact.Name: Illinois basic exemption, one person
Fact.Description: IDOR FY 2026-15 https://tax.illinois.gov/content/dam/soi/en/web/tax/research/publications/bulletins/documents/2026/fy-2026-15.pdf : "The personal exemption amount for tax year 2026 will increase to $2,925." 35 ILCS 5/204. One amount for single, head of household, married filing separately, and qualifying surviving spouse. Married filing jointly is two of these (Line 10a).

Fact.Name: Illinois additional exemption for age 65 or blindness
Fact.Description: 2025 IL-1040 instructions, Line 10 https://tax.illinois.gov/content/dam/soi/en/web/tax/forms/incometax/documents/currentyear/individual/il-1040-instr.pdf : "Multiply the number of boxes checked by $1,000." Each 65-or-older or legally-blind checkbox. Spouse checkboxes only if married filing jointly ("you or your spouse if married filing jointly").

Fact.Name: Illinois exemption income limit, other than joint
Fact.Description: 2025 IL-1040 instructions, Line 10 exemption chart: if federal AGI is greater than $250,000 (single, head of household, married filing separately, or widowed), the exemption allowance is zero. Greater than, so $250,000 still receives the exemption. 35 ILCS 5/204.

Fact.Name: Illinois exemption income limit, married filing jointly
Fact.Description: 2025 IL-1040 instructions, Line 10 exemption chart: if federal AGI is greater than $500,000 on a joint return, the exemption allowance is zero. Greater than, so $500,000 still receives the exemption. 35 ILCS 5/204.

Fact.Name: Illinois individual income tax rate
Fact.Description: 35 ILCS 5/201: for taxable years ending on or after December 31, 2017, 4.95 percent. 2026 draft IL-1040 Line 12: "Multiply Line 11 by 4.95% (.0495)." Ill. Const. art. IX, § 3(a). 2025 instructions, rounding: drop an amount under 50 cents and increase an amount of 50 through 99 cents.

Fact.Name: Illinois residency answers
Fact.Description: #93: full-year resident is the supported IL-1040. Part-year and nonresident need Schedule NR (35 ILCS 5/304). More than one state is not this return.

Fact.Name: Illinois residency for this return
Fact.Description: Asked when /filerResidenceAndIncomeState is Illinois. fullYear is the supported path. partYear, nonresident, and moreThanOne stop the return.

Fact.Name: Illinois Schedule M additions or subtractions
Fact.Description: IL-1040 Lines 3 and 7 are Schedule M. Not modeled. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: Claims the Illinois earned income or child tax credit
Fact.Description: Schedule IL-E/EITC is not modeled. Yes stops the return. A dependent in the household stops separately.

Fact.Name: Illinois Schedule ICR, 1299-C, CR, or 4255
Fact.Description: Lines 13, 15, 16, and 17. Those schedules are not modeled. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: Illinois use tax on Line 21
Fact.Description: The Use Tax (UT) Worksheet is not modeled. The supported entry is zero. Yes stops the return. 2025 instructions, Line 21: do not leave the line blank; enter zero if none.

Fact.Name: Illinois cannabis or gaming surcharge
Fact.Description: IL-1040 Line 22. Not modeled. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: Illinois pass-through withholding or PTE credit
Fact.Description: IL-1040 Lines 27 and 28. Not modeled. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: Illinois estimated payments or prior-year credit
Fact.Description: IL-1040 Line 26, including a credit carried from last year's return. Not federal estimates. Not modeled. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: Illinois Form IL-2210
Fact.Description: Underpayment penalty and the Line 34 checkboxes. IL-2210 is not modeled. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: Illinois Schedule G charitable donation
Fact.Description: IL-1040 Line 35. Schedule G is not modeled. Yes stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 1 federal AGI
Fact.Description: 2026 draft IL-1040 Line 1, federally adjusted gross income. 35 ILCS 5/203. Federal /agi. W-2 wages with no adjustments equal the W-2 box 1 total.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 2 federally tax-exempt interest
Fact.Description: Zero on the supported path. Tax-exempt interest stops the return (/flowKnockoutIlOtherFederalIncome). 35 ILCS 5/203.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 3 other additions
Fact.Description: Schedule M additions. Zero. A yes to /ilHasScheduleM stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 4 total income
Fact.Description: Line 1 + Line 2 + Line 3.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 5 Social Security and retirement subtraction
Fact.Description: Zero. Social Security, IRA, and pension income stop the return. 35 ILCS 5/203.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 6 Illinois income tax refund included in federal AGI
Fact.Description: Zero on this wages-only path.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 7 other subtractions
Fact.Description: Schedule M subtractions. Zero. A yes to /ilHasScheduleM stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 8 total subtractions
Fact.Description: Line 5 + Line 6 + Line 7.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 9 Illinois base income
Fact.Description: Line 4 minus Line 8, not less than zero. 2025 instructions, Line 9. On the supported path this equals Line 1.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 10a exemption amount
Fact.Description: $2,925, or $5,850 when married filing jointly (two basic amounts). Shown even when the Line 10 total is zero because AGI is over the limit.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 10b age-65 exemption
Fact.Description: $1,000 for each 65-or-older checkbox. The spouse checkbox counts only on a joint return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 10c legally-blind exemption
Fact.Description: $1,000 for each legally-blind checkbox. The spouse checkbox counts only on a joint return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 10d dependent exemption
Fact.Description: Zero. A dependent, or an Illinois EITC or CTC, stops the return. The reduced-exemption chart for a filer who can be claimed as a dependent is not used; that filer stops instead.

Fact.Name: Illinois exemption allowance disallowed by AGI
Fact.Description: Federal AGI greater than $500,000 on a joint return, otherwise greater than $250,000.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 10 exemption allowance
Fact.Description: Line 10a + 10b + 10c + 10d, or zero when /ilExemptionDisallowed. Sublines stay at the pre-limitation amounts.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 11 net income
Fact.Description: Line 9 minus Line 10, not less than zero. Residents use this line; Schedule NR is not modeled.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 12 after the cent-then-dollar round
Fact.Description: Round(Line 11 × 4.95%). Dollar×Rational scales to cents half-even before Round half-up, so a product whose exact fraction is .4950 through .4995 becomes .50 and then rounds up a dollar.

Fact.Name: One hundred times the exact IL-1040 Line 12
Fact.Description: Line 11 × 99/20. That is 100 × Line 11 × 0.0495, and for a whole-dollar Line 11 it is exact in cents. 35 ILCS 5/201.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 12 income tax
Fact.Description: Line 11 times 4.95 percent, rounded once. Under 50 cents drops; 50 through 99 cents rounds up. 35 ILCS 5/201. 2025 IL-1040 instructions. 52,075 × 0.0495 = 2,577.7125, which rounds to 2,578. 50,010 × 0.0495 = 2,475.495, which stays 2,475. 51,000 × 0.0495 = 2,524.50, which rounds to 2,525. The cent-then-dollar result is one dollar high when it exceeds this exact product by more than 50 cents.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 13 recapture
Fact.Description: Schedule 4255 recapture. Zero. /ilHasNonrefundableCredits stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 14 income tax
Fact.Description: Line 12 + Line 13.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 15 tax paid to another state
Fact.Description: Schedule CR. Zero. /ilHasNonrefundableCredits stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 16 property-tax credit
Fact.Description: Schedule ICR. Zero. /ilHasNonrefundableCredits stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 17 other credits
Fact.Description: Schedule 1299-C. Zero. /ilHasNonrefundableCredits stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 18 total credits
Fact.Description: Line 15 + Line 16 + Line 17.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 19 tax after nonrefundable credits
Fact.Description: Line 14 minus Line 18, not less than zero.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 20 household employment tax
Fact.Description: Zero. /flowKnockoutIlHouseholdEmployment stops the return. 35 ILCS 5/201.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 21 use tax
Fact.Description: Zero, and the PDF prints 0 rather than a blank. 2025 instructions, Line 21: enter zero if you owe no use tax. A yes to /ilHasUseTax stops the return. The UT Worksheet is not modeled.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 22 cannabis and gaming surcharges
Fact.Description: Zero. /ilHasCannabisOrGamingSurcharge stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 23 total tax
Fact.Description: Line 19 + Line 20 + Line 21 + Line 22.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 24 total tax from page 1
Fact.Description: Line 23, carried to page 2.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 25 Illinois income tax withheld
Fact.Description: Sum of W-2 box 17, also Schedule IL-WIT Line 11. 35 ILCS 5/502. A W-2 whose box 15 is not Illinois, including an Iowa, Kentucky, Michigan, or Wisconsin reciprocity state, stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 26 estimated payments
Fact.Description: Zero. /ilHasEstimatedOrPriorYearCredit stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 27 pass-through withholding
Fact.Description: Zero. /ilHasPassThroughWithholdingOrCredit stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 28 pass-through entity tax credit
Fact.Description: Zero. /ilHasPassThroughWithholdingOrCredit stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 29 Illinois EITC
Fact.Description: Schedule IL-E/EITC. Zero. Dependents or /ilClaimsIlEitcOrCtc stop the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 30 Illinois child tax credit
Fact.Description: Schedule IL-E/EITC. Zero. Dependents or /ilClaimsIlEitcOrCtc stop the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 31 total payments and refundable credits
Fact.Description: Lines 25 through 30.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 32 overpayment
Fact.Description: Line 31 minus Line 24 when Line 31 is greater; otherwise zero.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 33 tax due
Fact.Description: Line 24 minus Line 31 when Line 24 is greater; otherwise zero.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 34 underpayment penalty
Fact.Description: IL-2210. Zero. /ilNeedsForm2210 stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 35 Schedule G donations
Fact.Description: Zero. /ilHasScheduleGDonation stops the return.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 36 penalty and donations
Fact.Description: Line 34 + Line 35.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 37 overpayment after penalty and donations
Fact.Description: Line 32 minus Line 36 when Line 32 is greater; otherwise zero.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 38 refund
Fact.Description: The whole Line 37 overpayment is refunded. Nothing is credited forward (Line 40 is zero). A paper check is the refund method.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 40 credit forward
Fact.Description: Zero. The overpayment is refunded on Line 38.

Fact.Name: IL-1040 Line 41 amount you owe
Fact.Description: The form's three-way rule. Line 33 minus Line 36 when Line 33 is greater than Line 36. Line 36 minus Line 32 when Line 32 is greater than zero and less than Line 36. Line 36 when Line 36 is greater than zero and Lines 32 and 33 are zero. Otherwise zero. On the supported path Line 36 is zero, so this is Line 33. The PDF prints 0 when nothing is owed.

Fact.Name: Federal income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: Interest, tax-exempt interest, dividends, unemployment, Social Security, pensions, IRA and 1099-R, capital gain or a sale, Schedule C, Schedule E, 1099-MISC, or any other amount in federal total income besides W-2 wages. Adjustments that reduce AGI are not this stop.

Fact.Name: Filer can be claimed as a dependent
Fact.Description: IL-1040 Step 1, Line C. The primary filer, or either spouse on a joint return. The reduced exemption chart is not applied.

Fact.Name: Dependents or an Illinois EITC or CTC
Fact.Description: Anyone in the household, or a yes to /ilClaimsIlEitcOrCtc. Schedule IL-E/EITC is not modeled.

Fact.Name: W-2 box 15 not answered
Fact.Description: Box 15 has to be Illinois (same state as the residence) before Line 25 is printed.

Fact.Name: A W-2 box 15 is not Illinois
Fact.Description: differentState includes Iowa, Kentucky, Michigan, and Wisconsin. Those reciprocity states are not treated as Illinois. An unanswered box 15 also stops an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Primary filer W-2 count
Fact.Description: Schedule IL-WIT rows 1 through 5 are the primary filer's forms.

Fact.Name: Spouse W-2 count
Fact.Description: Schedule IL-WIT rows 6 through 10. Zero unless the return is joint.

Fact.Name: More W-2s than Schedule IL-WIT can show
Fact.Description: Five rows per person. More than that would leave Line 25 larger than the schedule.

Fact.Name: Illinois residency is part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: Incomplete until /ilResidencyStatus is answered.

Fact.Name: Illinois residency answer is more than one state
Fact.Description: Incomplete until /ilResidencyStatus is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Illinois part-year or nonresident
Fact.Description: Schedule NR is not modeled. 35 ILCS 5/304. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return. Incomplete until /ilResidencyStatus is answered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: lived in more than one state
Fact.Description: The Illinois residency question answered moreThanOne. The federal "more than one state" choice never reaches this return. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: W-2 box 15 is not Illinois
Fact.Description: Any box 15 other than Illinois, including Iowa, Kentucky, Michigan, and Wisconsin reciprocity, or a box 15 that was not answered. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: federal income other than W-2 wages
Fact.Description: IL-1040 Lines 2, 5, and the Schedule M income lines are not computed from this income. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return. Incomplete while a sale question is unanswered.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Illinois Schedule M
Fact.Description: Lines 3 and 7. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: dependents or Illinois EITC or CTC
Fact.Description: Schedule IL-E/EITC is not modeled. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Schedule ICR, 1299-C, CR, or 4255
Fact.Description: Lines 13, 15, 16, and 17. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Illinois household employment tax
Fact.Description: Line 20. A complete yes to the federal household-employee answer. The placeholder false on that fact is not a stop. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Illinois use tax
Fact.Description: Line 21 would be a positive amount. The supported printed amount is 0. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Illinois cannabis or gaming surcharge
Fact.Description: Line 22. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: pass-through withholding or PTE credit
Fact.Description: Lines 27 and 28. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Illinois estimated payments or prior-year credit
Fact.Description: Line 26. Not federal estimated tax. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Form IL-2210
Fact.Description: Line 34. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Schedule G donations
Fact.Description: Line 35. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: filer claimed as a dependent
Fact.Description: Step 1, Line C. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return. Incomplete until the filer's answer is known.

Fact.Name: Flow knockout: Schedule IL-WIT has too many W-2s
Fact.Description: The one-page schedule has five rows for the filer and five for the spouse. Complete false when this is not an Illinois return.
